_comment: Synthetic Elasticsearch documents for hider/eseval.py. Every value is
generated; the field names match templates/elastic.example.json and are
invented. Placeholders in braces: sensitive ones are drawn from the
document's own tenant and server so field and message correlate, and each
is recorded as ground truth. {N} {MS} {HTTP} {PCT} {BYTES} are noise.
clean_messages carry no customer value and seed the lookalikes (namespaces,
versions, byte counts, vendor hosts) that an over-eager tier would redact.
